The Cargo build script shells out to the pnpm dashboard build (vite). Bazel does not model the Node dashboard build step; the embedded dashboard assets are supplied as compile data instead.

The integration test clears the child environment and changes the child working directory before launching CARGO_BIN_EXE_rook. Cargo supplies an absolute executable path, but Bazel's portable runfiles path is relative to the test runfiles directory. Supporting this target requires a runfiles-aware test helper or test-source change, which is outside the permitted BUILD-only changes.
